value.signature: fn select (disable : Option < & OsStr > , level : Option < & OsStr > , kind : BuildKind) -> Result < Self , EmissionConfigurationError >

exception.justification: Justified: Pure selection runs before observation installation and cannot record itself.

review.body: { if let Some (value) = disable { match value . to_str () { Some ("1") => { if kind == BuildKind :: Debug { return Err (EmissionConfigurationError :: DebugCannotDisable) ; } if level . is_some () { return Err (EmissionConfigurationError :: ConflictingInputs) ; } return Ok (Self :: Off) ; } Some (_) => return Err (EmissionConfigurationError :: InvalidDisable) , None => return Err (EmissionConfigurationError :: NonUtf8Disable) , } } match level . map (OsStr :: to_str) { None | Some (Some ("default")) => Ok (Self :: Default) , Some (Some ("error")) => Ok (Self :: Error) , Some (Some ("trace")) => Ok (Self :: Trace) , Some (Some (_)) => Err (EmissionConfigurationError :: UnknownLevel) , Some (None) => Err (EmissionConfigurationError :: NonUtf8Level) , } }
review.item_premise: This pre-installation policy helper reads public mode inputs or immutable kind state without a private carrier or independent delivery; its terminal diagnostic belongs to the shared command boundary.
